_note: Retrieval gold set. Each entry is a question + the (source_table, source_id) of cases that MUST/SHOULD appear in the top-K retrieval. Entries below tagged 'bootstrapped' were auto-anchored from the corpus (a real case picked per topic, with a paraphrased question) — review/curate them with a lawyer's eye and promote 'should' -> 'must' once verified.

_format.id: stable short id, used in the report

_format.filters: optional SearchFilters applied as if the user set them in the UI (session filters)
